title: Subdomain Visit Count
description: Count how many times each subdomain is visited given a list of count-paired domains.
pseudocode:
1. counts = {}
2. for cp in cpdomains:
3.   count, domain = cp.split(' ')
4.   frags = domain.split('.')
5.   for i in range(len(frags)):
6.     sub = '.'.join(frags[i:])
7.     counts[sub] = counts.get(sub, 0) + int(count)
8. return [f"{v} {k}" for k, v in counts.items()]
